question: Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra campaign was flagged off by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi on November 15, 2023, at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Khrunti, Jharkhand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra** campaign was flagged off by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on **November 15, 2023**, from **Khunti, Jharkhand**. 
 
• This initiative was aimed at promoting the vision of a developed India by 2047, coinciding with the centenary of India’s independence.
 
• Along with the launch from Khunti, **multiple Information, Education and Communication (IEC) vans** were dispatched from various locations across the country. 
 
• These vans are designed to raise awareness about the government's development initiatives, encouraging public participation and engagement for national progress.
 
• Khunti is a significant location as it is associated with tribal heritage, and the launch in this region underscores the government’s commitment to uplifting tribal communities as part of its inclusive development agenda.
 
• The **Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra** is designed to promote the government’s vision of building a **self-reliant, developed, and prosperous India**.
 
• It emphasizes inclusivity and aims to involve people from all walks of life in contributing to the nation’s development.
